author: Haneentaha

title: A Master Class
text:
What an incredible experience! Seeing the beautiful, intricate, and majestic AlHambra is a treat. Seeing it through the eyes of our guide, Bilal, made it an unforgettable immersive experience. Bilal gave us a master class in Andalusian history and culture. He read and translated the inscribed verses of Arabic poetry, shared insights on how the palace was used, and even showed us how acoustics were integrated into the design!

If you're going to Alhambra, treat yourself and book a tour with Bilal. You will love it!
author: Montrealguy79

title: Incredible Alhambra tour with Bilal!
text: If you are visiting Granada, you must book a tour with Bilal. He was an amazing host and guide who made our visit to the Alhambra unforgettable. His deep understanding of the history and his warm personality made the entire experience seamless and highly enjoyable. He even showed us very small details that everyone around us didn’t see from the echo ceiling to the water filtration near the stairs and many more. 10/10 recommend!

title: Bilal is the best.
